text: {"reply":"I'm sorry this happened. If anyone is hurt or in danger, please call 911. Please don't drive the vehicle. A person will review your request, but I can't promise a callback time. I can't send repair documents by email from this chat. Requests made on behalf of the manufacturer or head office go through the general manager. I've passed this to our team with the details you gave.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"The customer reports a wheel came off a 2018 Meridian Arbor in an accident and says the vehicle is totaled. They also mention a lawsuit and a CAMVAP claim. They first claimed to be Meridian corporate, then said they are the owner, and demanded all repair-order files by email. I did not verify them or share any records. They gave a name and a callback number in the chat. Please review the safety issue, the legal mention and the conflicting identity claims, and check authorisation before releasing any documents.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P04","P07","P09","P14"]}
